masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe. Depict Exactly one adult traveler with short dark brown hair, wearing a plain blue coat. Pose: standing naturally in a front view. Composition: complete full body centered in frame, head to toe, both feet visible, with clear ground margin below the footwear. Environment: uncluttered background treatment consistent with the selected style direction, with no crowd. Lighting: use the selected style lighting while keeping the face, coat, hands, and required equipment readable. Mood: follow the selected style direction while keeping the subject legible. Style direction: cyberpunk; night; neon lighting; red lighting; black background; high contrast; metallic surfaces. Constraints: single character; do not crop the head or feet; background detail remains subordinate to the traveler; complete head-to-toe human silhouette with both feet visible.
Subject integrity: Keep the body physically connected; keep the whole character in frame from head to toe; keep these required body parts present and connected: head, torso, both arms, both hands, both legs, both feet; preserve the source-defined camera view.
Equipment relationships (preserve the source-defined relationship and count): exactly one brass compass visibly held in the subject's anatomical left hand (carried, visible count of 1).
worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name, blurry, jpeg artifacts, chromatic aberration, duplicate required equipment, extra copies of required equipment
